purpose: Development crosswalk showing where Course 6 harvest safety, postharvest receiving, source-to-output genealogy, contamination control, work-order authority and reconciliation/handoff objectives can be observed in Practical F. Mapping coverage does not constitute practical validation, product-release authority, evaluator calibration, inter-rater evidence, standard setting or release approval.

objectiveMappings.statement: Verify harvest authorization, work area, tools, PPE, pathways and task hazards before and during harvest, applying authorized routine controls and stopping or escalating unsafe conditions.
practicalTasks: Verify harvest authorization, room, batch and destination.
Verify work area, tools, required PPE, pathways and task hazards before beginning and when conditions change; apply only authorized routine controls and stop or escalate unresolved unsafe conditions.

objectiveMappings.statement: Execute authorized harvest, transfer and basic dry-room receiving steps while protecting harvested material from unnecessary damage, contamination and uncontrolled postharvest conditions.
practicalTasks: Prepare clean tools, cart, labels and receiving area.
Sequence simulated cut/movement while protecting lot identity.
Receive material into the dry room using the correct rack/lot identity.
Interpret basic dry-room environmental and product-condition information.

objectiveMappings.statement: Preserve plant, batch, lot, container and destination identity through harvest transformations and movements, explicitly linking source material to new harvest or receiving identifiers.
practicalTasks: Sequence simulated cut/movement while protecting lot identity.
Create or verify the source-to-harvest/receiving identifier link when material changes container, harvest lot or receiving identity so genealogy remains reconstructable.
Receive material into the dry room using the correct rack/lot identity.

objectiveMappings.statement: Maintain harvest sanitation and contamination-control boundaries, isolate or hold suspect material according to procedure, and prevent dirty, mixed or unlabeled material from entering normal flow.
practicalTasks: Prepare clean tools, cart, labels and receiving area.
Identify and isolate/hold suspect material using the supplied process.
Prevent dirty, mixed or unlabeled material from entering normal flow.

objectiveMappings.statement: Execute the supplied harvest and postharvest work order within Technician I authority, resolving destination, identity, hold or instruction conflicts before continuing the affected transition.
practicalTasks: Verify harvest authorization, room, batch and destination.
Resolve destination, identity, hold or instruction conflicts through the supplied process before continuing the affected transition; do not improvise an undocumented destination or release decision.
expectedEvidence: conflict-resolution/hold decision within Technician I authority

objectiveMappings.statement: Reconcile harvest counts, weights, movements and receiving status without forcing a false match, and produce a reconstructable handoff that preserves deviations, holds, unresolved conditions and required follow-up.
practicalTasks: Reconcile outgoing and receiving quantities without forcing a false match.
Complete the harvest/postharvest handoff and unresolved-issue note.
